_comment: GENERATED by scripts/publish-scenes.mjs. Maps each scene asset's logical path to the name Depot actually serves it under. Depot is CONTENT-ADDRESSED (/files/:bucket/:hash.:ext, 'independent of the uploader's original filename'), so a deployed build cannot ask for 'rho.glb' — it has to ask for the hash. Empty until the assets are published; a deployed build with an empty manifest fails loudly rather than 404ing every asset.
